name: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
description: Protects confidential information shared between parties.
use_case: Protecting confidential business or personal information.
sample_excerpt: This NDA is entered into by [Discloser] and [Recipient] to protect confidential information for the following purpose: [Purpose of NDA].
ai_prompt: Draft a Non-Disclosure Agreement between {discloser} and {recipient} for the purpose of {purpose}, effective from {effective_date}. Use formal legal terms.

name: Employment Contract
description: Outlines the terms of employment between an employer and employee.
sample_excerpt: This Employment Contract is made between [Employer] and [Employee] for the position of [Job Position], with a salary of [Salary], starting on [Start Date].
ai_prompt: Write a formal employment contract for {employee} hired by {employer} as {position}, with a salary of {salary}, starting {start_date}. Include standard employment terms.

name: Lease Agreement
description: Legal contract between a landlord and tenant for rental property.
sample_excerpt: This Lease Agreement is between [Landlord] and [Tenant] for the property at [Property Address], for a monthly rent of [Monthly Rent].
ai_prompt: Draft a lease agreement between {landlord} and {tenant} for the property at {address}, with a monthly rent of {rent_amount}, for the period from {start_date} to {end_date}.

name: Sales Agreement
description: Specifies terms of a sale between a buyer and a seller.
use_case: Selling or purchasing goods or property.
sample_excerpt: This Sales Agreement is entered into by [Seller] and [Buyer] for the sale of [Item Description] at a price of [Sale Price].
ai_prompt: Create a sales agreement between {seller} and {buyer} for the sale of {item} for {price} on {date}. Use formal contract language.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Governs the relationship and obligations between business partners.
sample_excerpt: This Partnership Agreement is made between [First Partner Name] and [Second Partner Name] for [Business Name] effective [Effective Date].
ai_prompt: Draft a partnership agreement for {business_name} between {partner_a} and {partner_b}, specifying a capital contribution of {capital_contribution}, effective {start_date}.

name: Articles of Incorporation
description: Legal document to form a corporation.
sample_excerpt: These Articles of Incorporation establish [Corporation Name] in [State of Incorporation] on [Date].
ai_prompt: Draft articles of incorporation for {corporation_name} in {state}, prepared by {incorporator} on {date}.

name: Operating Agreement (LLC)
description: Sets rules for the operation of an LLC.
use_case: Operating agreement for a Limited Liability Company.
sample_excerpt: This Operating Agreement governs [LLC Name], effective [Effective Date], with members: [Members].
ai_prompt: Write an operating agreement for the LLC named {llc_name}, located in {state}, with members {members}, effective {effective_date}.

name: Shareholder Agreement
description: Outlines rights and obligations of shareholders in a company.
sample_excerpt: This Shareholder Agreement is made between the shareholders of [Company Name] on [Agreement Date].
ai_prompt: Prepare a shareholder agreement for {company_name} between shareholders {shareholders} as of {date}.

name: Board Resolution
description: A formal decision made by a company’s board of directors.
sample_excerpt: The Board of Directors of [Company Name] hereby resolves: [Resolution Text] on [Resolution Date].
ai_prompt: Write a formal board resolution for {company_name}, stating: {resolution}, dated {date}.

name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
description: Details the expected service standards between a service provider and client.
sample_excerpt: This SLA is made between [Service Provider] and [Client] for [Service Description] with a response time of [Response Time].
ai_prompt: Draft a service level agreement between {provider} and {client} for {service_description}, with required response time of {response_time}, starting {start_date}.

name: Deed of Trust / Property Deed
description: Transfers ownership of real property.
sample_excerpt: This Deed transfers ownership of [Property Address] from [Grantor] to [Grantee] on [Transfer Date].
ai_prompt: Prepare a deed of trust transferring {property_address} from {grantor} to {grantee} on {date}.

name: Mortgage Agreement
description: Contract outlining the terms of a home loan.
sample_excerpt: This Mortgage Agreement is between [Lender] and [Borrower] for [Property Address], loan amount [Loan Amount], interest rate [Interest Rate].
ai_prompt: Draft a mortgage agreement between {lender} and {borrower} for {property_address}, loan amount {loan_amount}, interest rate {interest_rate}, starting {start_date}.

name: Eviction Notice
description: Legal notice issued to tenants to vacate a property.
sample_excerpt: Eviction Notice: [Tenant Name] must vacate [Property Address] by [Vacate By Date] due to [Reason for Eviction].
ai_prompt: Compose an eviction notice from {landlord} to {tenant} for the property at {property_address}, to be vacated by {vacate_date}, for the following reason: {reason}.

name: Last Will and Testament
description: Specifies how a person’s assets are to be distributed after death.
sample_excerpt: I, [Testator Name], declare this as my Last Will and Testament, appointing [Executor Name] as executor.
ai_prompt: Draft a last will and testament for {testator}, naming {executor} as executor, with beneficiaries {beneficiaries}, dated {date}.

name: Power of Attorney (POA)
description: Grants someone legal authority to act on another's behalf.
sample_excerpt: [Principal Name] grants [Agent Name] the following powers: [Powers Granted], effective [Start Date] to [End Date].
ai_prompt: Draft a power of attorney appointing {agent} as agent for {principal}, granting the following powers: {powers}, valid from {start_date} to {end_date}.

name: Prenuptial Agreement
description: Sets financial terms in case of divorce before marriage.
sample_excerpt: This Prenuptial Agreement is made between [First Party Name] and [Second Party Name] in anticipation of marriage.
ai_prompt: Compose a prenuptial agreement between {party_a} and {party_b}, to be married on {wedding_date}, setting terms for the following assets: {assets}.

name: Affidavit
description: A sworn written statement used as evidence in court.
sample_excerpt: I, [Affiant Name], swear the following statement is true: [Statement].
ai_prompt: Draft an affidavit for {affiant}, stating: {statement}, dated {date}.

name: Complaint / Petition
description: Initiates a lawsuit by outlining legal claims.
sample_excerpt: Complaint: [Plaintiff] files a legal claim against [Defendant] for [Legal Claim] on [Date].
ai_prompt: Draft a legal complaint by {plaintiff} against {defendant} for {claim}, dated {date}.

name: Summons
description: Notifies a party that legal action has been taken against them.
sample_excerpt: Summons: [Defendant] is summoned to [Court Name] by [Plaintiff] on [Summons Date].
ai_prompt: Prepare a court summons for {defendant}, initiated by {plaintiff}, to appear in {court} on {date}.

name: Settlement Agreement
description: A legal contract resolving a dispute without trial.
sample_excerpt: This Settlement Agreement between [First Party Name] and [Second Party Name] resolves the following dispute: [Dispute Description].
ai_prompt: Draft a settlement agreement between {party_a} and {party_b} for the dispute: {dispute}, with terms: {settlement_terms}, dated {date}.
